sourceDefinitionParaphrases.heading: ARMOR CLASS
sourceDefinitionParaphrases.sourceMeaning: Composite difficulty-to-hit measure reflecting worn protection, physical structure or magical nature, and speed/reflexes; the combined value does not need a high-Dexterity adjustment, and any necessary individual adjustment is stated in that entry.

sourceDefinitionParaphrases.heading: MOVE
sourceDefinitionParaphrases.sourceMeaning: Relative constant speed; higher short-duration speeds may occur, movement scales to the chosen time unit, multiple values can identify different media/modes, and a single value does not always prove ground-only travel.

sourceDefinitionParaphrases.heading: HIT DICE
sourceDefinitionParaphrases.sourceMeaning: Dice determine hit points; eight-sided dice are usual unless stated, listed dice are rolled and summed, at least one die applies, some creatures use smaller dice, and a plus value adds hit points.

sourceDefinitionParaphrases.heading: NUMBER OF ATTACKS
sourceDefinitionParaphrases.sourceMeaning: Counts physical attacks during one melee round; limb loss/spells can modify it, unusual attack forms are not normally included, and multiple attacks can represent different modes in a round.

sourceDefinitionParaphrases.heading: DAMAGE PER ATTACK
sourceDefinitionParaphrases.sourceMeaning: Gives hit-point damage for a successful attack; weapon damage may be omitted when it depends on the weapon, with mode-specific detail in the entry prose.

sourceDefinitionParaphrases.heading: SPECIAL ATTACKS
sourceDefinitionParaphrases.sourceMeaning: Names effects such as breath or magic use; the entry supplies method, frequency, damage and effects, and spellcasting level is generally hit-dice level unless specified.

sourceDefinitionParaphrases.heading: SPECIAL DEFENSES
sourceDefinitionParaphrases.sourceMeaning: Points to defenses such as defensive magic or camouflage, detailed in the entry prose.

sourceDefinitionParaphrases.heading: MAGIC RESISTANCE
sourceDefinitionParaphrases.sourceMeaning: Percentage chance a spell fails, based on an 11th-level magic-user and adjusted 5% per caster level; normal saves still apply after resistance is overcome, resistance protects immediate worn/carried possessions, and area spells may still affect other targets.
